content.title: Is there school today in Florida? See which counties start spring break
content.text: March 16, 2026, 6:01 a.m. ETStudents in 44 Florida counties started their spring break today, March 16.See spring break calendars by county.Schools districts in Florida determine their own holiday schedules.Spring break starts today, March 16, for students in 44 Florida counties.Three counties got a jump on the rest and will return to school Monday, March 16.Some students will have to wait until April to get their spring break.Each individual district decides when to schedule school holidays.Here's what you should know.Spring break starts today, March 16, for students in 44 Florida countiesMost Florida students, 44 out of Florida's 67 counties, will start their spring break the week of March 16:Alachua: March 16-March 20Bay: March 16-March 20Broward: March 16-March 20Charlotte: March 16-March 20Clay: March 16-March 23 (Monday, March 23 designated as planning day for teachers; students return March 24)Duval: March 16-March 20Escambia: March 16-March 20Flagler: March 16-March 2Franklin: March 16-March 20Gadsden: March 16-March 20Glades: March 16-March 20Gulf: March 16-March 20Hardee: March 16-March 20Hendry: March 16-March 20Hernando: March 16-March 20Highlands: March 16-March 20Hillsborough: March 16-March 20Jefferson: March 16-March 20Lake: March 16-March 20Lee: March 16-March 20Leon: March 16-March 23.
